rules_ds:
from pitch_lib import midi_note, Hz, midi_hz

schema Tone scope logical:
    id: String key
    note: midi_note mutable

schema Pitch scope logical:
    id: String key
    freq: Hz mutable

rule to_pitch:
    Tone t
->
    emit Pitch logical id: t.id freq: midi_to_hz(t.note)

rule a3:
    Pitch p where p.freq == 220_Hz
->
    log info "a3 is 220"

libraries.pitch_lib:
from math import log2

unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency
unit scalar pitch storage float64
unit midi_note: pitch

unit formula midi_hz:
    midi_to_hz(x: midi_note): Hz   = 440.0 * 2.0 ** ((x - 69.0) / 12.0)
    hz_to_midi(x: Hz): midi_note   = 69.0 + 12.0 * log2(x / 440.0)
